name: SIGNALS_AHEAD_YELLOW_DIAMOND

w3-3_signals.desc: traffic signal pictogram: body 140 wide x 642 tall with three lamp hoods (lamps dia 120 at 165 spacing, first lamp 110 below body top, 202 from lowest lamp to body bottom), hoods to 185 (lower corner) / 210 (upper corner) from axis with 10/65/60/15 profile, base 70 wide x 87 tall, top hook 55 wide x 25 tall on a 5 neck; overall 420 wide x 672 tall (642 + 30 hook).

notes: Diamond 750 side drawn as bounding square 750*sqrt2 = 1060.66 (centre 530.33); R50 outer, 10 yellow edge, 30 black border (as drawing). No position dimension on the sign: placed with the middle lamp centre on the sign centre (body top 275 above centreline, hook top 305 above, bottom 367 below), which matches the drawing (measured -305 / +371). Overall height 672 = 642 body + 25 hook + 5 neck (hook dims read from inset).
